description: Defines the conditions under which revelation occurs. Revelation is the state transition in which an observer's detection capacity δ exceeds the structural opacity ω, making internal configuration accessible.

δ.description: Observer detection capacity — the maximum structural depth and complexity an observer can resolve.
δ.source: Determined by observer methodology, context, and resolution; estimated via OR-Δ (DetectionCapacity) using Book 3 SD-Σd as substrate.

ω.description: Structure opacity — the degree to which the structure conceals its internal configuration.
ω.source: Property of the structure's configuration. Assigned via OR-Ω (OpacityGradient). Invariant under observer change (INV-OR-003).

revelation_states.description: Observer's detection capacity does not exceed structural opacity. Internal configuration is not accessible. Structure appears as a black box.
revelation_states.action: Proceed to LatentProbe (OR-Λ) to identify structural shadows.

revelation_states.description: Observer is exactly at the opacity boundary. Marginal revelation conditions. Assigned to opaque state by conservatism principle.
revelation_states.action: Treat as opaque. Record δ = ω event for monitoring. Do not declare revelation.
revelation_states.conservatism_principle: When δ = ω, structural integrity demands the opaque assignment. False revelation is a category error; false opacity is recoverable.

revelation_states.description: Observer's capacity strictly exceeds structural opacity. Internal configuration is accessible at the current δ level.
revelation_states.action: Proceed to PartialIndex (OR-Π) to characterize revelation extent.

observer_capacity_model.description: δ(O) is observer-dependent and context-sensitive. It represents the practical resolution ceiling of the observer's detection methodology.
observer_capacity_model.estimation_method: Use Book 3 SD-Σd (SignalDetection) output as the substrate δ estimate, then apply OR-Δ context adjustment.
observer_capacity_model.context_sensitivity: δ may vary for the same observer across contexts (e.g., access to different tools, information, or resolution instruments).
observer_capacity_model.book3_binding: SD-Σd operator output feeds δ estimation in OR evaluation context.

revelation_failure_modes.label: Capacity Underestimate
revelation_failure_modes.description: Observer assumes δ is lower than its actual value, failing to attempt detection that would succeed.
revelation_failure_modes.detection: Post-revelation audit reveals sub-structures that should have been accessible given actual δ.

revelation_failure_modes.label: Opacity Underestimate
revelation_failure_modes.description: Observer assumes ω is lower than its actual value, attempting and expecting revelation that does not materialize.
revelation_failure_modes.detection: Revelation attempt returns opaque state when revealed was predicted.

revelation_failure_modes.label: Threshold Confusion
revelation_failure_modes.description: Treating δ = ω as the revealed state rather than opaque — violates the conservatism principle of INV-OR-002.
revelation_failure_modes.detection: Revelation declared without δ > ω verification.

revelation_failure_modes.label: Static Capacity Assumption
revelation_failure_modes.description: Assuming δ is fixed across all contexts when context changes shift observer resolution capacity.
revelation_failure_modes.detection: Consistent revelation failures in one context despite success in another.

revelation_failure_modes.label: Observer Conflation
revelation_failure_modes.description: Assuming that one observer's revelation constitutes revelation for all observers, ignoring δ variance.
revelation_failure_modes.detection: Revelation state attributed to structure rather than the observer-structure pair.

threshold_audit_checklist: ω(S) has been assigned by OR-Ω and is recorded
δ(O) has been declared by OR-Δ and is recorded
Comparison δ > ω evaluated — not δ ≥ ω
Threshold case (δ = ω) assigned to opaque
revelation_state is one of {opaque, threshold, revealed}
No observer identity has been used to modify ω
